mcp_marketplace_steps: In the ChatGPT or Codex Plugins Directory, choose the TableCast source and install the plugin. Sign in to TableCast and review the restaurant and permissions when connecting.
mcp_repository_status: The GitHub package currently points to localhost:3000. Before distributing a hosted version, its maintainer must set the public HTTPS URL. Repository distribution is separate from public directory publication.
mcp_developer_enable: Open Settings → Security and login → Developer mode. Availability depends on your account and workspace policy.
mcp_developer_connect: Use the plus button in Plugins to create an MCP connection with the server URL and OAuth. Sign in to TableCast and approve the restaurant and permissions.
mcp_developer_package: Pass the plugin_asdk_app ID from the connection URL to plugin-creator to wire it into a local plugin with the existing TableCast skill. Install it from the Plugins Directory and test it in a new conversation.
mcp_remote_requirement: ChatGPT cloud cannot reach localhost directly. Use public HTTPS or Secure MCP Tunnel. Local Codex can use this URL.
mcp_local_steps: Start the development server in this repository and run these commands from its root. They generate a source and Codex configuration for the current development URL.
mcp_local_install: Restart the app, select the TableCast source in the Plugins Directory and install the plugin. Use a new Codex task.
mcp_manual_steps: Add these settings in an MCP client supporting Streamable HTTP, OAuth PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration (DCR). Sign in, then choose the restaurant and permissions.
mcp_skill_steps: Download SKILL.md and place it at tablecast/SKILL.md in your client’s skill directory. Codex supports .agents/skills in the repository.
mcp_skill_requirement: The skill provides instructions for managing restaurant settings. It does not grant MCP access or OAuth permissions; complete the connection setup above too. For clients without skills, use its contents in the client’s instruction settings.
mcp_scope_read: Read menu, service settings and drafts.
mcp_scope_write: Create, edit, validate and request publication of drafts. Read access is also required.
mcp_scope_boundary: Access is limited to the approved restaurant and your membership permissions. Final publication requires approval in the TableCast dashboard.
mcp_session_empty: No connections. Start with Plugin installation or Manual setup.
